rules.rule_name: Atypical Acute Coronary Syndrome (Female / Diabetic Presentation)

conditions: female or diabetic presentation with sudden unexplained autonomic symptoms

clinical_action.explanation: Atypical myocardial infarction presentation can lack crushing substernal chest pain, especially in females and diabetics.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Immediate 12-lead ECG, cardiac troponin, and emergency department redirection

rules.known_limitations: Does not replace continuous cardiac telemetry and emergency physician clinical assessment.

rules.rule_name: Acute Coronary Syndrome / Acute Myocardial Infarction Sentinel Presentation

conditions: acute retrosternal chest pain or pressure consistent with myocardial ischemia

clinical_action.explanation: Acute myocardial infarction requires emergency reperfusion within the critical therapeutic window.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Immediate EMS transport (call 123/911/997/112), 12-lead ECG within 10 minutes, chewable aspirin 300mg if no allergy, STAT cardiology catheterization team activation

rules.source_authority: ESC / AHA STEMI & NSTE-ACS Clinical Guidelines
rules.known_limitations: Requires confirmatory 12-lead ECG and high-sensitivity cardiac troponin assays.

rules.rule_name: Acute Stroke & Intracranial Hemorrhage Sentinel Red Flag (FAST Protocol)

conditions: acute onset focal neurological deficit or worst headache of life

clinical_action.explanation: Time is brain: Acute ischemic stroke requires non-contrast head CT and IV thrombolysis/thrombectomy within 4.5 hours.
clinical_action.immediate_action: STAT emergency code stroke activation, determine last known normal time, zero oral intake (NPO), immediate emergency transfer to stroke center

rules.source_authority: AHA/ASA Guidelines for Early Management of Acute Ischemic Stroke
rules.known_limitations: Clinical screening does not differentiate ischemic from hemorrhagic stroke without immediate head CT.

rules.rule_name: Acute Upper Airway Obstruction & Imminent Respiratory Arrest

conditions: acute compromised upper or lower airway with hypoxemia or exhaustion

clinical_action.explanation: Acute stridor or silent chest signals imminent complete airway occlusion or severe asthmatic exhaustion.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Emergency airway management, high-flow oxygen, prepare for emergent endotracheal intubation or cricothyroidotomy

rules.source_authority: Difficult Airway Society (DAS) / ERC Resuscitation Guidelines
rules.known_limitations: Physical airway inspection must occur in controlled operating room or resuscitation bay.

rules.rule_name: Severe Acute Anaphylaxis with Airway or Cardiovascular Collapse

conditions: multisystem allergic reaction with respiratory difficulty or hypotension

clinical_action.explanation: Anaphylaxis is rapidly fatal if intramuscular epinephrine is delayed.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Immediate intramuscular Epinephrine (adrenaline 0.5mg adult / 0.15-0.3mg pediatric) into anterolateral thigh, supine position, call EMS immediately

rules.known_limitations: Antihistamines and corticosteroids are adjuncts only and must never substitute for prompt IM epinephrine.

rules.rule_name: Septic Shock & Hemodynamic Instability Red Flag

conditions: suspected severe infection with organ hypoperfusion or refractory hypotension

clinical_action.explanation: Septic shock carries mortality >40% without rapid bundle resuscitation.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Immediate ICU/ED resuscitation: IV crystalloid bolus 30 mL/kg, blood cultures, broad-spectrum IV antimicrobials within 1 hour, serum lactate measurement

rules.known_limitations: Requires laboratory confirmation of lactate, blood cultures, and continuous arterial pressure monitoring.

conditions: active upper or lower GI bleeding with hemodynamic instability

clinical_action.explanation: Massive upper or lower GI hemorrhage leads to hemorrhagic shock and cardiac arrest.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Two large-bore IVs (16G/18G), type and cross-match 4 units pRBCs, IV proton pump inhibitor / octreotide, STAT gastroenterology emergent endoscopy

rules.source_authority: ACG Clinical Guideline: Upper Gastrointestinal and Ulcer Bleeding
rules.known_limitations: Endoscopic intervention must be performed in resuscitation setting.

rules.rule_name: Pediatric Non-Blanching Purpuric Rash with Lethargy (Meningococcemia)

conditions: child with fever and non-blanching petechial or purpuric rash

clinical_action.explanation: Non-blanching purpuric rash with lethargy indicates fulminant meningococcal septicemia or severe sepsis.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Immediate emergency resuscitation, urgent parenteral ceftriaxone/penicillin, and pediatric ICU admission

rules.known_limitations: Glass tumbler test is a helpful lay aid but must not delay emergency transport.

conditions: female of reproductive age with acute unilateral pelvic pain and hemodynamic instability

clinical_action.explanation: Ruptured tubal pregnancy leads to life-threatening intra-abdominal exsanguination.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Emergency gynecology consult, STAT bed-side FAST ultrasound, beta-hCG, cross-match blood, and surgical intervention

rules.source_authority: ACOG Practice Bulletin No. 193 (Tubal Ectopic Pregnancy)
rules.known_limitations: Negative urine pregnancy test rarely misses early ectopic; serum quantitative hCG required.

rules.rule_name: Acute Suicidal Ideation with Plan or Intent

conditions: active expression of suicide with accessible means or plan

clinical_action.explanation: High acute risk of lethal self-harm requiring immediate crisis intervention and safe holding.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Never leave patient alone; connect to national crisis lifeline (988 in US, 08008880700 in Egypt, 997 in Saudi Arabia) and transfer to emergency psychiatric evaluation

rules.source_authority: WHO Suicide Prevention Guidelines / APA Practice Guideline
rules.known_limitations: Digital tools cannot physically secure patient environment or remove lethal means.
